passages.title: Notice 1
passages.text: SWIMMING POOL: The shallow end is currently closed for essential maintenance. Please use the deep end or the outdoor lanes until further notice. We apologise for any inconvenience.

passages.title: Notice 2
passages.text: GYM MEMBERS: Please remember to wipe down all weight machines after use. Cleaning spray and paper towels are provided at every station. Thank you for keeping our gym clean.

passages.title: Notice 3
passages.text: LOST PROPERTY: A pair of blue goggles was found in the changing rooms yesterday. Please speak to the front desk staff if you think they are yours.

passages.title: Notice 4
passages.text: YOGA CLASS: The 6:00 PM yoga session on Thursday is cancelled due to instructor illness. All booked members will receive a credit on their account automatically.

passages.title: Notice 5
passages.text: SAUNA RULES: For safety reasons, please do not stay in the sauna for more than 15 minutes. Ensure you drink plenty of water before and after your session.

questions.question: What should swimmers do while the shallow end is being repaired?
questions.explanation: The notice states to use the deep end or outdoor lanes.
options: a) Wait until the maintenance is finished.
b) Avoid using the pool entirely.
c) Use a different part of the pool.

questions.question: What are gym members expected to do after using equipment?
questions.explanation: The notice asks members to wipe down machines using the provided supplies.
options: b) Ask staff to clean the machine.
c) Bring their own cleaning supplies.

questions.question: What should someone do if they lost their goggles?
questions.explanation: The notice instructs the owner to speak to the front desk staff.
options: a) Leave a note for the staff.
c) Check the changing rooms again.

questions.question: What happens to members booked for the cancelled yoga class?
questions.explanation: The notice says they will receive a credit automatically.
options: a) Their account will be credited.
b) They will get a refund in cash.
c) They must rebook for another day.

questions.question: What advice is given to sauna users?
questions.explanation: The notice advises limiting time and drinking water.
options: a) Only use the sauna once a day.
b) Limit the time spent inside.
c) Stay in for at least 15 minutes.
